details.description: Delight your dog with Cesar wet dog food, a deliciously premium range crafted for adult dogs. This complementary dog food is best served along with a complete and balanced meal such as Pedigree dry food. Made with high-quality ingredients, this gourmet meal features tender steamed Sasami, cooked to preserve its natural taste and flavour. With its rich taste and lower fat content, it serves as an indulgent yet balanced treat for your dog. The jelly base enhances palatability, while 87% moisture and ~35 kcal per pack make it a hydrating and light addition to your dog’s diet. Because every dog deserves a delicious moment of joy.
